# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
 
Packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "pheatmap")

lapply(Packages, library, character.only=TRUE)
```

```{r source_function, include=FALSE}
#Source Functions
source("functions.R")
source("missingness_visualization_functions.R")
```

```{r set_path, include=FALSE}
png_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch1_raw"
svg_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch1_raw/svg"
csv_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch1_raw/csv"
```

## Load Dataset(s)

```{r LoadDataset, include=FALSE}
#Peak Area Values
batch1_peak_area = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/8_untargeted_developing_2025.xlsx',sheet="Area",range=NULL)

#Metabolite Annotations

batch1_compound_annotation = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/8_untargeted_developing_2025.xlsx',sheet="Annotation", range=NULL)

#Sample Metadata

batch1_sample_metadata = read_excel('../../doc/untargeted/8_metadata.xlsx',sheet="metadata",range=NULL)

#Rename SampleName to Sample in metadata if needed
batch1_sample_metadata <- batch1_sample_metadata %>%
  rename(Sample = SampleName)
```

## Format Datafiles and Combine
```{r data_format}
# Clean the data
clean_metabolomics_data(batch1_peak_area, batch1_sample_metadata, batch1_compound_annotation, dataset_name = "batch1")

```

# Peak Features
## Peak Intensity

```{r long_format}
batch1_long <- prepare_long_data(batch1_peak_data, batch1_sample_metadata)
```

```{r peak_intensity}
# Peak Intensity
intensity_plots <- plot_all_intensity(
  data_long = batch1_long,
  title_prefix = "batch1 raw ",
  png_path = png_path,
  svg_path = svg_path
)

print(intensity_plots)
```

## Peak Detection
```{r peak_detection}
peak_detection_df <- calculate_peak_detection(
  dataset = batch1_peak_data,
  sample_metadata = batch1_sample_metadata,
  sample_cols = 4:11
)

detection_plots <- plot_all_detection(
  peak_detection_df = peak_detection_df,
  title_prefix = "batch1 raw ",
  png_path = png_path,
  svg_path = svg_path
)

# Get a summary
summarize_peak_detection(peak_detection_df)
print(detection_plots)
```

## Metabolite Missingness
```{r metabolite_missing}
missing_stats_full <- calculate_missingness(
  dataset = batch1_peak_data,
  sample_cols = 4:11
)

  dataset = batch1_peak_data,
  sample_metadata = batch1_sample_metadata,

)

missingness_plots <- plot_all_missingness(

  svg_path = svg_path
)
print(missingness_plots)
```

# Abundant Peaks

## Individual Metabolites
```{r calculate_abundance}

  dataset = batch1_peak_data,
  sample_cols = 4:11,
```

## Initial PCA

```{r PCA_One, echo = TRUE}
# PCA of sample variation
# Prepare data for PCA (samples as rows, metabolites as columns)
samples_matrix <- batch1_peak_data %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample")) %>%
  t()

# 1/5th min value imputation
samples_matrix <- apply(samples_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_samples <- prcomp(samples_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add Sample labels
sample_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_samples$x)
sample_scores$Sample <- rownames(sample_scores)

# Merge sample scores with metadata
sample_scores <- sample_scores %>%
  left_join(batch1_sample_metadata, by = "Sample")

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_samples <- pca_samples$sdev^2 / sum(pca_samples$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_samples),
  VarExp = var_explained_samples
)

sample_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Samples") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_elbow, "sample_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_elbow)

# Plot PCA for samples
sample_pca <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]), title = "PCA of Sample Variation")

save_dual_format(sample_pca, "sample_pca", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca)
# Sex PCA
sample_pca1x2_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_sex, "sample_pca1x2_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_sex)

sample_pca2x3_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca2x3_sex, "sample_pca2x3_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca2x3_sex)

# GW PCA
sample_pca1x2_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_gw, "sample_pca1x2_gw", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_gw)

sample_pca2x3_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca2x3_gw, "sample_pca2x3_gw", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca2x3_gw)

# PCA of metabolite variation
# Prepare data for PCA (metabolites as rows, samples as columns)
metabolites_matrix <- batch1_peak_data %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample"))

metabolites_matrix <- apply(metabolites_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_metabolites <- prcomp(metabolites_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add metabolite labels
metabolite_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_metabolites$x)
metabolite_scores$Compound.ID <- batch1_compound_annotation$Compound.ID

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_metabolites <- pca_metabolites$sdev^2 / sum(pca_metabolites$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_metabolites),
  VarExp = var_explained_metabolites
)

metabolite_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Metabolites") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_elbow, "metabolite_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(metabolite_elbow)
# Calculate distance from origin for each metabolite
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(distance = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2))

# Define a threshold for labeling outliers.
# This threshold can be adjusted based on the spread of your data.
threshold <- quantile(metabolite_scores$distance, 0.99)

# Create a logical column to indicate if the metabolite is an outlier
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(is_outlier = distance > threshold)

# Plot PCA for metabolites with outlier labels
metabolite_pca1x2 <- ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Compound.ID, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_pca1x2, "metabolite_pca1x2", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(metabolite_pca1x2)

metabolite_pca2x3 <- ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Compound.ID, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[3]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_pca2x3, "metabolite_pca2x3", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(metabolite_pca2x3)
```
